# KOSIF TOOL — Claude superpowers and Arabic-first motion-graphics atlas

> A Claude Code skill that tells Claude what it can really do: 5,851 powers in 62 families and 10 domains, each with an evidence badge (1017 proven by real runs), the requirements to run it, 174 runnable tools, executable thinking tools, and a 289-style motion-graphics atlas.

Start with CAPABILITIES.md, then the skill's SKILL.md. Inside Claude Code run `python3 .claude/skills/kosif-superpowers/scripts/boot.py`, then `python3 .claude/skills/kosif-superpowers/scripts/hub.py find "<task>"` (tools to run + powers + guides in one answer).

## Start
- [CAPABILITIES.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-tool/main/CAPABILITIES.md): generated self-model for Claude
- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-tool/main/.claude/skills/kosif-superpowers/SKILL.md): the skill and its power-up protocol
- [INDEX.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-tool/main/.claude/skills/kosif-superpowers/references/INDEX.md): every runnable tool, guide and power family on one page
- [manifest.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-tool/main/.claude/skills/kosif-superpowers/manifest.json): the same as JSON for apps and agents (tools, families, guides, counts)
- [tools.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-tool/main/.claude/skills/kosif-superpowers/data/tools.json): the tool registry (schema: .claude/skills/kosif-superpowers/schemas/tools.schema.json)
- MCP: `python3 .claude/skills/kosif-superpowers/scripts/kosif_mcp.py` is a read-only stdio MCP server (kosif_find, kosif_tool, kosif_power …); the repo's .mcp.json registers it
- [cognition.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-tool/main/.claude/skills/kosif-superpowers/references/cognition.md): how to think, plan, decide and create
- [requirements.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-tool/main/.claude/skills/kosif-superpowers/references/requirements.md): what each power needs and what each install unlocks
